label: Database optimization screenshot
blurb: A screenshot of a slide with Postgres indexing tips.
pages:
Postgres indexing: 5 rules that fixed our slow queries
1. Run EXPLAIN ANALYZE before adding any index
2. A B-tree index speeds up equality and range filters
3. Use a GIN index for full-text search and jsonb
4. A partial index keeps the index small: WHERE status = 'active'
5. Avoid SELECT * and fetch only the columns you need
p95 query latency dropped from 840 ms to 90 ms.

pages:
Sparse Routing for Long-Context Retrieval
A. Verma and L. Okafor
Abstract: We study retrieval over documents longer than 100 pages.
Our sparse routing method improves recall by 12 percent over a dense baseline.
We release code and an evaluation set.

Results
On the long-document set, recall at 10 rose from 61 percent to 73 percent.
Latency increased by 8 percent.
Conclusion: sparse routing is a practical way to read long documents.
Code: https://example.org/sparse-routing
